description: Prior Notification under  Schedule 2, Part 3, Part G of the GPDO for the change of use of the existing first-floor ancillary accommodation associated with the ground-floor pharmacy (Use Class E) to one self-contained one-bedroom flat (Use Class C3)
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use from Commercial, Business and Service (Use Class E), or betting office or pay day loan shop to mixed use including up to two flats (Use Class C3)
decision_conditions: The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The refuse and recycling facilities as shown on the approved plans shall be provided prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates and shall be permanently retained thereafter. The developer and/or their successors in title shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development are either stored within these facilities or internally within the building(s) on the application site, and that no refuse or recycling material is stored or placed for collection on the public highway except on the day of collection.Reason: To ensure proper waste management in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy SI17 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The proposed works are considered to fall within the parameters of  permitted development as set out under Schedule 2, Part 3, Classes G of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Prior to the commencement of the development to which this permission relates, a noise insulation assessment and report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to ensure internal spaces meet noise level requirements outlined in BS8233:2014. The noise insulation scheme shall demonstrate that the development meets the following noise level requirement with windows open:Living rooms and bedrooms during the daytime (0700 to 2300 hours) - internal noise levels of 35 dB LAeq for 16no hours Bedrooms during the night (2300 to 0700 hours) - internal noise levels of 30 dB LAeq (and up to 45 dB LAFmax for sudden peak noises) for 8no hoursIf the noise mitigation measures would not meet the acceptable noise levels with windows open, then prior to the commencement of any works associated with this application, a noise insulation strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to ensure the appropriate acoustic ventilation. The report shall detail mitigation measures designed so that nuisance will not be caused to them.The report shall be authored by a suitably qualified acoustic consultant/engineer and shall take into account the provisions of BS 8233:2014 "Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings".The approved mitigation measures shall be implemented prior to beneficial occupation of the development and be permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for the occupants of the development, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.These details are required prior to commencement of development because the relevant works would take place at the beginning of the construction phase and the details are likely to affect the design of other elements of the scheme.
